description: Registers a new catchy-me account and emails a 6-digit code to confirm it (then confirm_sign_up). Set accept_terms=true ONLY after the user has read and agreed to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy (their links: catchy_info terms_of_use / privacy_policy) — ask them first. Without a password one is generated and returned once: give it to the user. Returns signup_token for confirm_sign_up. [REST: POST /api/auth/register/start]

accept_terms.description: The user agreed to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

invite.description: An invite code, when registration is by invitation.

lang.description: The account's language: ru, en, es (Spanish), de (German), fr (French), pt (Brazilian Portuguese) or ja (Japanese); the messages, the emails and the texts of its searches. Default en.

name: sign_up
title: Create a catchy-me account
